decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, while also protecting yourself with cards like Cling to Dust and Demolition Field. The deck aims to maintain card advantage and board control through cards like Sheoldred's Edict and March of Wretched Sorrow, while also ramping up mana with cards like Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth. The deck also includes powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out the game. The overall strategy revolves around resource management and strategic decision-making.

This aggro deck focuses on casting efficient creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and reduce their life total to zero. Using a mix of creatures with varying abilities and powerful spells, the deck aims to deal damage as quickly as possible and keep the pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional layer of strategy and consistency to the deck. Ultimately, the goal is to win the game before the opponent can set up their own game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly building up +1/+1 counters on creatures through cards like Hardened Scales and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp. By using cards that can generate tokens or move counters around like Hangarback Walker and The Ozolith, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures. The inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and Inkmoth Nexus also provide additional threats and ways to close out the game swiftly. The deck aims to be proactive and aggressive, using synergy between its cards to create a powerful board presence.

This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on disruption and early creature pressure to control the board and limit the opponent's options. Utilizing cards like Ragavan, Grief, and Thoughtseize to strip the opponent's hand while creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Orcish Bowmasters put pressure on the battlefield. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats efficiently. With a mix of disruption, early aggression, and powerful creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and secure a win.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to generate extra mana and take advantage of land bounce lands like Gruul Turf and Simic Growth Chamber in order to play Primeval Titan early. The goal is to quickly ramp into powerful threats like Primeval Titan and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to overwhelm the opponent and win the game. The deck also includes cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and The One Ring to provide additional support and synergy with the land-focused strategy.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures that can be searched for and put into play using cards like Chord of Calling and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician. The deck includes a toolbox of creatures with specific abilities to help control the board or advance the game plan, such as Wall of Roots for ramp and Young Wolf for resilience. The key strategy is to use the combo potential of the creatures and support cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Zulaport Cutthroat to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This Modern Aggro deck focuses on maximizing synergy with +1/+1 counters through cards like Hardened Scales and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp. The deck aims to rapidly grow creatures like Walking Ballista and Patchwork Automaton, using cards like Urza's Saga and The Ozolith to generate value. With a mix of artifact creatures, mana acceleration, and protection spells like Welding Jar, this deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with its powerful creatures and efficient synergy. The goal is to establish a strong board presence early on and maintain pressure throughout the game.

The main idea of this deck is to use cascade spells like Architects of Will and Ardent Plea to cascade into Living End, a powerful sorcery that allows the player to return all creature cards from their graveyard to the battlefield. By filling the graveyard with creatures using cards like Street Wraith and Generous Ent, the player can then cast Living End, effectively wiping the board and setting themselves up for a lethal attack. The deck also includes counter spells like Force of Negation and disruption creatures like Curator of Mysteries to control the game until the combo is assembled.

The deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between lands and creatures to ramp up quickly and assemble the key pieces, such as Primeval Titan and Amulet of Vigor, to generate powerful and explosive plays that overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Arboreal Grazer, Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, and the bounce lands, the deck is able to generate a large amount of mana and take advantage of land triggers to set up a lethal Titan attack or create a board state that is difficult for the opponent to deal with.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay using a diverse combination of creatures and spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly. With a mix of efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu, along with powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames, the deck aims to establish an early board presence and deal damage swiftly. The inclusion of Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding helps to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional flexibility and support for the deck's aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with cycling abilities to quickly fill up the graveyard, then casting Living End to bring all those creatures back onto the battlefield at once, overwhelming the opponent with a sudden board presence. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation and Subtlety to control the opponent while setting up the combo. It combines tempo control with explosive payoff, creating a unique and powerful combo strategy in the Modern format.

This deck aims to cycle through cards quickly and use cascade mechanics to cast Living End, a powerful sorcery that returns all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield. By filling the graveyard with creatures through cycling and other effects, the deck can reset the board and gain a significant advantage over the opponent. The combination of card draw, creatures with cycling abilities, and cascade spells allows for consistency in setting up the game-winning Living End play. The deck's strategy revolves around overwhelming the opponent with a sudden and powerful board presence.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells in the Rakdos color combination. It focuses on early game pressure with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and removal spells like Fatal Push and Kolaghan's Command ensures that the deck can maintain its aggression while controlling the board. Overall, it excels at quickly closing out games and keeping the opponent on the back foot.

This deck focuses on utilizing The Underworld Cookbook to enable graveyard recursion and aggressive plays. It includes a mix of powerful creatures and burn spells to quickly pressure the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Ovalchase Daredevil and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer allows for card advantage and quick damage, while cards like Tarmogoyf and Finale of Devastation provide versatility in different matchups. The synergy between various cards in the deck, along with the ability to quickly close out games, makes it a potent Aggro archetype in Modern.

This deck focuses on applying constant pressure on the opponent by utilizing aggressive creatures like Grief and Dauthi Voidwalker, as well as disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Liliana of the Veil. The deck also includes various tools such as Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Fatal Push to control the opponent's board and keep the pressure on. The main goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly reducing their life total, ultimately winning the game through aggression and disruption.

This deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing a combination of efficient removal spells and disruptive creatures to quickly disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining low-cost threats like Grief and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer with powerful disruption like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, the deck aims to control the board and pressure the opponent early. Additionally, the deck includes versatile cards like Angrath's Rampage and Kolaghan's Command to deal with various threats while maintaining pressure. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent through a combination of aggression and disruption.
